t: This is the monument to James Braidwood in Abney Park Cemetery, in Hackney. Braidwood is buried here, and this is where he is commemorated. He was a Scottish firefighter who became the first Master of Engines in Edinburgh in 1824, in what is described as the world's first municipal fire service. He later became the first director of the London Fire Engine Establishment. He is credited with developing the modern municipal fire service, which is why a firefighter's memorial stands among the graves.
